questions.question: Can I return an opened laptop on day 8 if I have the original box and all accessories?
questions.reference_answer: Yes. Under the current policy effective 1 July 2026, opened laptops can be returned within 10 days of delivery if they are in good condition and include the original box, all accessories, manuals and the invoice. (An older 2025 ticket mentions a 7-day window, but the current policy replaces it.)

questions.question: My Galaxy Buds3 Pro left earbud won't connect. Is this a known issue, and has the same problem been resolved for another customer? What fixed it?
questions.reference_answer: Yes, it's a known issue, usually after pairing with a new phone. Put both earbuds in the case and close the lid for 10 seconds, then reset them from the Galaxy Wearable app (or by holding both touchpads for 7 seconds) and pair again as a new device. A previous customer had the same problem after switching phones (TCK-1001): the earbuds were still paired with the old phone, and resetting and pairing again as a new device fixed it. If it still doesn't work, treat it as defective (within 48 hours of delivery) or raise a warranty claim.

questions.question: How long does delivery take to a remote pincode, and is it free?
questions.reference_answer: Delivery to remote pincodes takes 5 to 9 business days. The normal delivery charges apply, so orders of Rs 499 and above are still free. Express delivery isn't available for remote pincodes.

questions.question: A customer wants to change the address after the order shipped. What is the official process, and do we have a resolved case like this?
questions.reference_answer: Official process (OG-002): the address can't be changed after shipping. The customer can ask the courier to reschedule delivery to the same address, or refuse the delivery and place a new order with the correct address. Resolved case (TCK-1004): a customer who had moved refused the delivery of a shipped Sony WH-1000XM5 order and placed a new order with the new address. The refund for the first order was issued after the package reached the warehouse.

questions.question: What does policy RR-004 say?
questions.reference_answer: Refunds start after the returned product passes the quality check. UPI and wallet: 1 to 3 business days. Credit/debit card and net banking: 5 to 7 business days. Cash on Delivery: to the customer's bank account within 5 to 7 business days, after they add bank details on the Orders page. EMI: refunded to the card, and the bank closes the EMI plan.

questions.question: A customer received a damaged phone and wants a refund instead of a replacement. What is the official process, and do we have a previous resolved case where a refund was issued?
questions.reference_answer: Official process: the customer must report it within 48 hours of delivery using Report a Problem, with photos of the product, box and shipping label, plus an unboxing video if available. A pickup is scheduled and the product goes through a quality check. For mobile phones, a replacement is given first; a refund is given only if a replacement unit (same model and colour) isn't available. Refund timelines depend on the payment method: UPI and wallet 1 to 3 business days, cards and net banking 5 to 7 business days. Resolved case (TCK-1002): an iPhone 16 arrived with a cracked screen; a replacement was not available in the same colour, so a full refund was issued to the credit card.

questions.question: Can I use Cash on Delivery for a Rs 60,000 laptop?
questions.reference_answer: No. Cash on Delivery is only available for orders up to Rs 50,000. Orders above Rs 50,000 must be paid online.

questions.question: Which cities have express delivery, what does it cost, and is it free above Rs 499?
questions.reference_answer: Express delivery is available in Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Mumbai and Pune. Orders placed before 2 PM are delivered the next day. It costs Rs 149 per order even for orders above Rs 499, and it is not available for Cash on Delivery orders.

questions.question: Does the iPhone 16 come with a charger, and will the Anker 20W charger fast-charge it?
questions.reference_answer: No, the iPhone 16 box has only the phone and a USB-C to USB-C cable; no power adapter. Yes, the Anker 20W USB-C Charger supports USB-C Power Delivery and fast-charges the iPhone 16 with a USB-C to USB-C cable.

questions.question: A customer's MacBook Air M3 shows 'Not Charging' with a phone charger. Is this a known issue, and have we resolved it for someone before?
questions.reference_answer: Yes, it's a known issue: a 20W phone charger such as the Anker 20W is not enough to charge the MacBook Air M3 while in use. The fix is to use the Apple charger from the box or a USB-C Power Delivery charger of 30W or more. A previous ticket (TCK-1008) had the same root cause and the laptop charged normally after switching to a 30W+ charger.

questions.question: Do AirPods Pro 2 work with Android phones, and what should a customer do if one earbud isn't charging in the case?
questions.reference_answer: Yes, AirPods Pro 2 work with Android phones as normal Bluetooth earbuds, though features like automatic switching and iOS setup work only with Apple devices. If one earbud isn't charging, the usual cause is dirt on the charging contacts: clean the earbud and case contacts with a dry cotton swab and make sure the earbud sits fully in the case. If it still doesn't charge, raise an Apple warranty claim.

questions.question: A customer says payment failed but money was deducted. What should the support team tell them?
questions.reference_answer: No order is created for a failed payment. The bank usually reverses the amount within 5 to 7 business days. The support team should check the payment status and share the transaction reference with the customer if the reversal takes longer.

questions.question: Tracking hasn't updated for 5 business days. What should support do, and has this happened before?
questions.reference_answer: If tracking has not updated for more than 3 business days, the support team should raise a courier escalation. A previous case (TCK-1013) had tracking stuck for 4 business days on a ThinkPad E14 order; after the escalation the courier found the package at a hub and delivered it within 2 days.

questions.question: Have we had a case where a Cash on Delivery refund was not received? What was the root cause?
questions.reference_answer: Yes (TCK-1006). A customer returned an Anker 20W charger bought with Cash on Delivery and did not get the refund. The root cause was that bank details had not been added on the Orders page. After adding them, the refund was credited in 5 business days.

questions.question: If a replacement unit is also defective, what does the policy say, and do we have a past case like that?
questions.reference_answer: A product can be replaced only once per order; if the replacement is also defective the customer gets a full refund (RR-005). In TCK-1011 a Galaxy S25 with a faulty speaker was replaced and the replacement had a display flicker, so a full refund was issued by UPI within 2 business days.

questions.question: A prepaid order has already shipped and the customer wants to cancel it. What can they do, and how is the refund handled?
questions.reference_answer: Once shipped, an order cannot be cancelled. The customer can refuse the delivery instead. The order is then returned to Dandes Electronics and, for prepaid orders, a full refund is issued once the package reaches the warehouse.
